title: National CCDC official scoring protocol

official_scoring_components.name: Service points
official_scoring_components.basis: Operating and maintaining identified critical network services.

official_scoring_components.name: Inject points
official_scoring_components.basis: Timely and satisfactory completion of business tasks delivered during the competition.

other_official_rules: A team's interruption of the scoring system is the team's responsibility and results in a lower score.
Manipulating a system to mislead the scoring engine may cause penalties or disqualification.
Official scores are maintained by competition officials; running totals are not provided.

published_weight_information.service_points: roughly half of possible points at regional events
published_weight_information.inject_points: roughly half of possible points at regional events

applicability.scope: National CCDC rules and the regional-event scoring model described by the national organizer.
applicability.qualifiers: Qualifier scoring varies; the official FAQ describes challenge completion, malware removal, and correction of misconfigurations rather than the regional two-component model.
applicability.local_variation: Regional and local event rules may vary.

provenance.title: NCCDC Frequently Asked Questions — How are CCDC events scored?

supports: published team packets identify scored services and the live operational scenario
all benchmark records leave total_points null

limitations: No exact service weights, inject weights, penetration deductions, SLA values, recovery-service costs, or total possible score are published in the cited national sources.
This file must not be used to claim or reconstruct hidden CCDC scoring.
The archived team packets are scenario briefs, not complete live inject sets, scoring-engine configurations, or official score sheets.
No numeric synthetic rubric is supplied because doing so would invent official criteria or weights.
